in_marathi.name: Ayushman
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Life giver, longevity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ayushman हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ayushman is derived from the Sanskrit words 'ayus' which means 'life' and 'man' which means 'man'. This name is often used in Hindu culture to bless a child with long and healthy life. The name is also associated with Lord Dhanvantari, the divine physician, who is believed to bestow good health and longevity on his devotees.
